cards.example_en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
cards.example_zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词意为“关着的”；也是close的过去式和过去分词。

cards.example_en: Learning becomes easier when I practise a little every day.
cards.example_zh: 每天练习一点，学习就变得更容易了。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。

cards.example_en: Public libraries provide resources that support lifelong learning.
cards.example_zh: 公共图书馆提供支持终身学习的资源。

cards.example_en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭前，我们去湖边钓鱼了。
cards.explain_zh: 说“去钓鱼”用go fishing，不用go to fishing。

cards.example_en: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.
cards.example_zh: 严格限制商业捕鱼能帮助海洋生态系统恢复，并长期支持沿海社区的生计。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
cards.example_zh: 她戴着一条带有小鸟吊坠的银项链。
cards.explain_zh: 结尾-lace读/ləs/，不是单词lace的读音。

cards.example_en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
cards.example_zh: 她戴着一条带有小鸟吊坠的银项链。

cards.example_en: I found my missing slipper underneath the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 我在沙发下面找到了丢失的那只拖鞋。
cards.explain_zh: 通常用复数slippers；人字拖常叫flip-flops。

cards.example_en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
cards.example_zh: 在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。
cards.explain_zh: 整个西瓜可数；指切开的瓜肉时常不可数。

cards.example_en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
cards.example_zh: 你用这支新笔写的字工整多了。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

cards.example_en: These boots keep my feet dry when I go hiking.
cards.example_zh: 我去远足时，这双靴子能让双脚保持干爽。
cards.explain_zh: 通常指乡野长途步行；也可作hike的现在分词。

cards.example_en: These boots keep my feet dry when I go hiking.
cards.example_zh: 我去远足时，这双靴子能让双脚保持干爽。

cards.example_en: His blond hair looked almost white in the sunshine.
cards.example_zh: 他的金发在阳光下看起来几乎是白色的。
cards.explain_zh: blonde常用于女性；词义不限定肤色。

cards.example_en: His blond hair looked almost white in the sunshine.
cards.example_zh: 他的金发在阳光下看起来几乎是白色的。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
cards.example_zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。
cards.explain_zh: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

cards.example_en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。
cards.explain_zh: 英国通常指草地曲棍球；美国通常指冰球。

cards.example_en: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old harbour.
cards.example_zh: 我们花了一上午在老港口一带观光。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；说go sightseeing，不加a。

cards.example_en: He showed me a drawing of his cat.
cards.example_zh: 他给我看了一幅他画的猫。
cards.explain_zh: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
cards.example_zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。
cards.explain_zh: dessert有两个s，重音在后；desert作沙漠时重音在前。

cards.example_en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
cards.example_zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We usually eat lunch together in the school canteen.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常一起在学校食堂吃午饭。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。

cards.example_en: We usually eat lunch together in the school canteen.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常一起在学校食堂吃午饭。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The builder replaced the broken bricks around our doorway.
cards.example_zh: 建筑工人更换了我们家门口周围破损的砖块。
cards.explain_zh: 可指建筑工人，也可指承建房屋的公司。

cards.example_en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
cards.example_zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。
cards.explain_zh: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

cards.example_en: Please include your ZIP code when entering your address.
cards.example_zh: 填写地址时，请附上你的美国邮政编码。
cards.explain_zh: 用于美国；英国通常说postcode，统称postal code。

cards.example_en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。
cards.explain_zh: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

cards.example_en: A green pea rolled off my plate during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时，一颗青豌豆从我的盘子里滚了出去。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
cards.example_zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.meaning_zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
cards.example_en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
cards.example_zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

cards.example_en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 据天气预报，今天下午会下雨。
cards.explain_zh: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

cards.example_en: Travelling by train gives me time to enjoy the scenery.
cards.example_zh: 乘火车旅行让我有时间欣赏沿途风景。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写双写l；美式通常写traveling。

cards.example_en: Travelling abroad can broaden students' perspectives by exposing them to different customs and ways of life.
cards.example_zh: 出国旅行能让学生接触不同的习俗和生活方式，从而拓宽视野。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
cards.example_zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。
cards.explain_zh: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。

cards.example_en: My grandfather still uses a tape-recorder to record songs.
cards.example_zh: 我祖父仍用磁带录音机录制歌曲。
cards.explain_zh: 现代通常写作tape recorder，不加连字符。

cards.example_en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
cards.example_zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。
cards.explain_zh: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。

cards.example_en: Our goldfish swims between the plants in its large tank.
cards.example_zh: 我们的金鱼在大鱼缸里的水草间游来游去。
cards.explain_zh: goldfish单复数同形：one goldfish，two goldfish。

cards.example_en: Please turn on the air-conditioning before the guests arrive.
cards.example_zh: 请在客人到来之前打开空调。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；一台空调机用an air conditioner。

cards.example_en: Please turn on the air-conditioning before the guests arrive.
cards.example_zh: 请在客人到来之前打开空调。

cards.example_en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
cards.example_zh: 画了一下午画后，他的书桌变得脏乱不堪。
cards.explain_zh: messy可指物品脏乱，也可指局面复杂难处理。

cards.example_en: We need a litre of milk for this pudding.
cards.example_zh: 做这道布丁需要一升牛奶。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写litre，美式liter；复数加s。

cards.example_en: We need a litre of milk for this pudding.
cards.example_zh: 做这道布丁需要一升牛奶。

cards.example_en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
cards.example_zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。
cards.explain_zh: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

cards.example_en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
cards.example_zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

cards.example_en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。
cards.explain_zh: 整个菠萝可数，作为食物的菠萝果肉常不可数。

cards.example_en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。

cards.example_en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
cards.example_zh: 我们躲进一间木屋避雨。
cards.explain_zh: hut强调简小朴素，通常不是设施齐全的住宅。

cards.example_en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
cards.example_zh: 我们躲进一间木屋避雨。

cards.example_en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
cards.example_zh: 这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。
cards.explain_zh: go sour可指食物变质，也可指关系变坏。

cards.example_en: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
cards.example_zh: 共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨期间，我们待在室内下棋。
cards.explain_zh: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。

word.example_en: Schools can encourage independent learning by giving students opportunities to investigate questions beyond the standard curriculum.
word.example_zh: 学校可以让学生探索常规课程之外的问题，以鼓励自主学习。
